title: Forgetting Without Restarting: Execution-State Unlearning for Stateful LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.04875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-running LLM agents are stateful: beyond the transcript they accrete compressed summaries, plaintext memory, pending tool plans, and, under every serving API, a KV cache. Yet today's "forget" operations delete a plaintext memory record and stop, leaving every artifact derived from the revoked information intact. We formalize execution-state unlearning: after a forget request, the agent must behave as if it had never observed the target. Modeling the runtime as a deterministic transition system, we prove that the pre-target trajectory prefix is shared with this counterfactual world for free, that the post-target suffix is irreducibly tainted without token-level attribution, and that exact unlearning requires at least $T-\tau+1$ recomputed transitions, where $\tau$ is the target's injection step. Provenance-Guided Selective Replay attains this bound as a cross-layer contract spanning prompt, compressed memory, and cache: a provenance

translated_title: 无需重启的遗忘：面向有状态LLM智能体的执行态遗忘
translated_abstract: 长时间运行的LLM智能体是有状态的：除了对话记录之外，它们还会不断积累压缩摘要、明文记忆、待执行的工具计划，以及在每个服务API底层存在的KV缓存。然而，当今的“遗忘”操作仅仅是删除一条明文记忆记录便就此停止，导致所有由被撤销信息派生出的产物依然完好保留。我们形式化了执行态遗忘问题：在收到遗忘请求后，智能体的行为必须表现得好像从未观测过目标信息一样。通过将运行时建模为确定性转移系统，我们证明了目标信息注入之前的轨迹前缀可以与这一反事实世界免费共享，目标之后的后缀在没有词元级归因的情况下不可还原地被污染，而精确遗忘至少需要T−τ+1次重计算转移，其中τ为目标信息的注入步骤。我们提出的溯源引导选择性重放作为横跨提示、压缩记忆与缓存的跨层契约达到了这一理论下界……
tldr: 本文首次形式化了有状态LLM智能体的“执行态遗忘”问题，证明了精确遗忘至少需要T−τ+1次重计算转移的理论下界，并提出溯源引导的选择性重放方法，无需重启智能体即可在提示、压缩记忆和KV缓存三个层面彻底消除被撤销信息的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes execution-state unlearning for stateful LLM agents, proves that exact unlearning requires at least T−τ+1 recomputed transitions, and proposes Provenance-Guided Selective Replay, which attains this bound as a cross-layer contract spanning the prompt, compressed memory, and KV cache without restarting the agent.
